dailyClose.title: Daily close
dailyClose.intro: One row per business day. A day that is not closed shows its date and blank figures.
dailyClose.totalsNote: {days} closed days included. The average is total sales divided by total orders.
dailyClose.ordersMissingNote: {days} closed days have no order count, so the average may be overstated.
dailyClose.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed. No figures are shown.
dailyClose.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.

cashCount.title: Cash count
cashCount.intro: Expected cash is the cash expected at the moment of the count. A deposit made later does not change the count result.
cashCount.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed, so there is no count to show.
cashCount.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.
cashCount.recalcOk: Recalculating at count time gives the same stored result.
cashCount.recalcDiffers: Recalculation differs from the stored result.
cashCount.noCount: No cash count was saved for this day. It is not counted, and no match is shown.

status.match: Match: the count equals the expected cash.
status.cannot_reconcile: Counted, but the expected cash cannot be calculated because opening cash, sales or card is blank.

cashCount.afterCountNote: These movements happened after the count. They change the cash in the drawer, not the count result.
cashCount.drawerAfter: Cash in the drawer after later movements
cashCount.expectedAtClose: Expected cash after all movements of the day
cashCount.previewHelp: Type a counted amount to see the result as at {time}. Leave it empty for “not counted”. 0 is a real count of zero.
cashCount.pendingBody: Who counted the cash and who was the cashier are not recorded yet. The role rules are decided in Phase 4.

comparison.title: Branch comparison

comparison.invalidQuery: Part of the address was not valid, so a default is shown instead.
comparison.coverageWeekly: Current date: {current} of {total} branches have figures. Prior date: {prior} of {total}.
comparison.allPresent: Every selected branch has figures on both dates.

status.before_live: Unavailable: before the first live date

ratioReason.different_branches: Unavailable: the two totals cover different branches.

growthReason.no_such_day: No such day in one of the months.
growthReason.before_live: Unavailable: before the first live business date.

periodReason.no_comparable_day: Unavailable: no day is entered in both months.
periodReason.prior_zero: Unavailable: the prior period total is 0.

comparison.incomplete: Incomplete total: not every selected branch has a figure on both dates.
comparison.complete: Complete total: every selected branch has a figure on both dates.
comparison.historical: Historical figure selected for this report
comparison.liveFromFirstClose: First live business date: {date} (first saved business day)
comparison.liveFromUnset: No first live business date set
comparison.undecided: Live source and entry owner: awaiting Abdo's decision
comparison.comparableDays: {n} day(s) entered for every selected branch in both months
comparison.inProgress: The current month is in progress: {elapsed} of {days} days have started.
comparison.beforeLiveDays: Days before the first live business date

modes.correct: A correction of a figure already entered

purposes.historical: Historical figure for a report (before the first live date)

catalog.intro: Sold products, ingredients and packaging, their units, the Foodics names that map to them, and the recipe versions that turn a sale into consumption. Nothing here posts stock; that starts in Phase 6.

items.statusHint: A discontinued item stays in the catalog. Its recipes, its names and every past day keep resolving to it.
items.recipeLink: Open the recipes of this product

conversions.intro: How many {unit} one of another unit holds, for this item only. Units of the same kind (kg and g) need none.
conversions.basis: Basis (who confirmed it, or the source)
conversions.locked: A conversion used by an approved recipe cannot change.

labels.title: Names in the sources

review.intro: Names, add-ons and units that cannot be used until a person decides them. Each entry names the exact source rows. Only the affected consumption stays blocked.
review.limit: Showing the first {n} entries. Use the filters to narrow the list.

unmapped_name.help: This name came from Foodics and no product is approved for it.

unconfirmed_mapping.name: Mapping to confirm
unconfirmed_mapping.help: The two source names may be the same product, but a person has not confirmed it.

ambiguous_addon.help: The add-on is written differently on the sales row and in its recipe.

missing_unit.name: Missing unit
missing_unit.help: A recipe line has a quantity but no unit.

untracked_component.name: Ingredient outside the inventory list

recipe_effective_date.help: Only Abdo can say when the November recipe set started.

review.dateHold: The November recipe versions stay drafts until this is answered.

consumption.intro: Enter the sold lines of a business day to see which can be consumed through an approved mapping, a convertible unit and an approved recipe, and which are blocked and why. Nothing is saved or posted here.
consumption.linesHint: One per row: Foodics name | quantity
consumption.totals: Total consumption of the eligible lines
consumption.queue: Add the unmapped names to the review queue
consumption.unreadable: Row {rows} could not be read as «name | quantity». It is shown as blocked.
consumption.tooManyLines: Enter up to 500 lines and 20,000 characters per check.

reason.mapping_pending: The mapping for this name is waiting for approval.
reason.mapping_rejected: This name was rejected and has no product.

reason.no_recipe_for_date: No approved recipe covers this business date.

warning.discontinued_before_date: This product was discontinued on {date}; the sale is still consumed.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: Expected stock, physical counts and variance for the business day. A dash means not counted; 0 is a counted zero.
stock.summary: {date}: {counted} counted, {missing} daily items not counted yet.
stock.legend: Expected at count uses the movements recorded up to the count time. Variance = count − expected at count.

form.countHint: Enter 0 when the item was counted and none is left. Leave an item out when it was not counted.
form.movementHint: Receipts are recorded on the day they actually arrive.
form.adjustHint: An adjustment changes the book only after approval. The count stays as observed.
form.openingHint: Once per item, before any other movement of it.

mix.title: Product Mix
mix.intro: Enter the Foodics Product Mix: each section with its printed total, then its lines. Section totals are checks and are never counted as sales. Lock the report when it reconciles, then post consumption through the approved recipes.
mix.none: No Product Mix has been entered for this day.
mix.notReconciled: The report does not reconcile yet.

mix.sectionHint: Entering an existing section name again corrects its total.
mix.lineHint: A name can appear once per section, so an overlapping photo portion cannot be entered twice.

history.title: Stock history
history.intro: Every movement and count from {from} to {to}, in {unit}, with who recorded it and when.

replenishment.title: Replenishment planning
replenishment.intro: Three-month same-weekday history per item, the forecast, and every input of the suggested order quantity. Missing days are left out, never counted as 0.

settings.title: Replenishment settings
settings.intro: Open decisions. Everything starts empty and changes nothing until the branch confirms it.
settings.liveFromWhere: Set the first live date in the comparison settings
settings.leadDays: Days to delivery (exception to the two-day rule)
settings.baseUnitNote: Quantities are in the item's base unit. Blank = not confirmed (no effect). Safety stock may be 0.
settings.viewPlan: View the plan of this item
settings.noneSet: No item has a setting yet.

dates.title: Dates
dates.planExpected: Receipt date used in this plan
dates.ruleNote: Expected receipt = order business date + 2 calendar days. An order created before 02:00 belongs to the previous business day.

formula.title: How the suggestion is calculated
formula.text: Suggested = forecast demand + safety stock − usable stock at the expected receipt − eligible confirmed incoming, never below 0. Pack size and supplier minimum apply afterwards, once confirmed.
formula.usable: Usable stock: today's book stock, plus confirmed deliveries before the receipt date, minus the forecast of each day until then (when history allows).
formula.incoming: Eligible incoming: approved, not yet received quantities expected inside the coverage window. Each is counted once.
formula.history: Forecast: the average of complete same-weekday days in the last 13 weeks, from the first live date. A day whose Product Mix is not fully posted is missing and left out.

replenishment.summary: {recommend} item(s) with a suggestion, {review} in review.
replenishment.mismatch: {n} item(s): the page check disagrees with the database. Do not order from these figures; report it.

reason.minimum_unset: The minimum number of observations is not decided.
reason.insufficient_history: Not enough complete same-weekday days yet. Order manually.

warning.bridge_unavailable: {date}: not enough history to subtract that day's consumption.
warning.coverage_exceeds_shelf_life: The coverage is longer than the shelf life ({days} days).

item.title: Item plan
item.intro: Quantities in {unit}. Every figure comes from recorded stock movements, Product Mix postings and approved orders.
item.checked: Recalculated on the page: same result as the database.
item.effect: Effect of moving the receipt from {from} to {to}:

bridge.title: Stock until the receipt
bridge.intro: Day by day from today's book stock. Stock never goes below 0.

basis.forecast_remaining: Forecast minus what is already posted

incoming.title: Confirmed incoming
incoming.none: No approved order is outstanding for this item.

order.title: Purchase order
order.intro: Every date is kept separately. Stock changes only through saved receipts.
order.legacyRule: Old order sheet value «{value}» ({cell}) read as the expected receipt date.
order.receiveHint: Enter what arrived. Each line creates one stock receipt on the day it arrived. More than the outstanding quantity needs an over-receipt reason.
order.cancelHint: Closes the line for the quantity not received. No stock is created; the history stays.

bucket.before_receipt: Before the receipt: in usable stock

history.title: Three-month history by weekday
history.intro: Complete days count, including a real 0. Missing days are shown and left out.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.intro: Business date, creation time, original and current expected receipt, and actual receipts, side by side.

new.title: New purchase order
new.intro: One branch per order. Each line: item, unit, numeric quantity and source (factory or store).
new.dates: Business date and default expected receipt:
new.reviewLine: In review: no suggestion. Enter the quantity yourself.
new.reasonHint: required when the final quantity differs from the suggestion
new.manualHint: Leave a row empty to skip it.

questions.minimum: How many complete same-weekday days does an item need before we trust the average?
questions.safety: How much extra stock should each item keep above the expected consumption (safety stock)?
questions.constraints: Pack sizes, supplier minimums, shelf life and order cut-off times per supplier?
questions.twoDay: Exceptions to the two-day rule: a supplier, a weekend or a holiday?
questions.cutoff: Which business day does an order created after midnight belong to?

exports.title: Excel reports
exports.intro: Choose a report, its period and the workbook language. Each file is built from saved data, checked, stored privately and recorded with the revisions it came from. A finished file never changes; export again to include later corrections.
exports.none: You have no report you may export.

familyHint.sales_comparison: Al Quds, Maarif, Bourgogne and their total: one weekday against the same weekday, or a month against the previous month.
familyHint.daily_sales: Sales, orders, average order value, cash, expenses, card and ratios for every day of the month.
familyHint.daily_statement: One sheet per closed day: expenses, card, counted cash and the reconciliation saved at count time.
familyHint.daily_ledger: Cash and purchasing-custody ledgers, sales, payments, count, cancellations, carry-forward and the month summary.
familyHint.inventory: Product Mix, recipe consumption, stock movements, counts, deviation and purchase orders with their three dates.

exports.drafts: Include days that are not closed (draft export)
